page_subtitle: Identity used to attach your objects (workspaces, strategies, keys) and attribute MCP calls made on your behalf.
email_help: Identity pivot: matches your account at OIDC sign-in (email claim from the identity provider).
email_change_warning: Changing your email changes the ownership key of your objects — existing workspaces and strategies will need to be migrated.
identity_help: Set the SAME GUID here as in your portal profile: MCP calls routed through the portal will be attributed to you (OBO contract).
identity_note: Empty = calls through the portal stay attributed to the API key, not to you.
error_identity_taken: This GUID is already used by another user.
error_email_taken: This email is already used by another user.
